TRUST & SAFETY

· TRUST & SAFETY ·

Real brands. Real money. Real safety rails.

Every brand campaign on Funngro is reviewed before it goes live. Every payout runs on UPI rails operated by India's largest banks. Your data stays in India. And if anything ever goes wrong, there's a real human you can call.

· FOUR PILLARS ·

01
Verified accounts

Every Funngro account is verified at sign-up via OTP. Real person, one account. Prevents fake profiles, protects honest earners, and keeps brand campaigns clean.

—
OTP verification at sign-up
—
Duplicate-account detection
—
No bot accounts. Ever.
02
Verified brand campaigns

Every brand campaign passes a content-moderation review before going live. We don't run anything we wouldn't want our own kids doing — no adult content, no gambling, no MLM, no anything sketchy.

—
Content moderation on every brief
—
Brand identity verified
—
Payout escrow before launch
03
Instant UPI payout

Money lands in your UPI account in seconds for repeat earners; first-time payouts within 24 hours of submission. Zero withdrawal fees. The rails are operated by India's largest banks — same as your salary or any other UPI transfer.

—
Repeat payout in seconds
—
First payout under 24 hours
—
Zero withdrawal fees
04
DPDP-compliant data handling

Your data stays in India. We collect the minimum needed to match you to the right campaigns — including your mobile number, which we also use to verify you and to keep fraudulent and duplicate accounts off the platform. You can delete your account anytime in three taps inside the app: we remove your personally identifiable data within 90 days, and keep only your mobile number (or a secure hash of it) plus a minimal account record to block repeat fraud, along with anything the law requires.

—
Data residency: India only
—
Consent-first tracking
—
Delete-my-data flow in-app, cleared within 90 days

· REPORT AN ISSUE ·

A real team. A real inbox.

If something goes wrong — an unfair task rejection, a brand behaving badly, a data concern — we have a dedicated safety team. You can email or escalate inside the app. Most platforms in this category don’t even publish a contact. We do.

EMAIL

Safety inbox

teenlancer@funngro.com

INSIDE THE APP

Report flow

Profile → Help → Report an issue

RESPONSE TIME

Median

Under 4 hours
